head: Ethos family routine app shares chores and schedules on iPhone
dek: Ethos is a new planner for your own weekly routine and the household's: shared routines, rotating chores and a shared shopping list, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. It's free to use, and Ethos Plus costs 99 cents a month, 4.99 dollars a year or 12.99 dollars once.
details: You set each weekday's routine once and tick tasks off on a timeline; there are no streaks, and a skipped day can be moved or made light. Joining a group is free; Plus adds iCloud sync, inviting people to groups, family events, recipes linked to the shopping list and Apple Health ticking. The listing says there's no account or server, and no ads or analytics. It's made by Patrick Sibale, came out on 6 November and got version 1.2 on 17 November.
where: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch; free, Ethos Plus optional
means: If your family's week is spread over a calendar, notes and the group chat, Ethos puts routines, chores and shopping in one place.
todo: Try the free version first; Plus is only needed to invite others or sync over iCloud.
thumb_words: ETHOS: ONE PLAN FOR THE FAMILY
